shortDescription: BEVERLY, Mass., Sept. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ATN International, Inc. NASDAQ:ATNI announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.29 per share, payable on October 9, 2026, on all common shares outstanding to stockholders of record as of October 3, 2026.About ATNAT…
